question: Are the mock tests similar to the actual exam?
answer: Yes, our mock tests are designed to match the latest exam pattern and syllabus. They help you get familiar with the question format, difficulty level and time management.

question: How long do I get access to the mock tests?
answer: You get access to the mock tests for the duration specified in your selected package. You can use this time to practice questions, review your performance and prepare for the actual exam.

question: Do you provide study material along with mock tests?
answer: Our mock tests are designed to help you prepare through exam-style questions and practice. Any additional study material included depends on the specific exam package you choose.
